g.text: Preparing a workspace on the default branch and serving it with the project’s run commands. This can take a few minutes…
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.
The profile picker shows only when the project has run profiles; switching profiles restarts the run ('Restarting with profile X…'). 🗑 asks 'Delete this run?'.

On failure the tab shows the error in red, then '▶ Try again'; if the page itself fails, it offers an 'Open in your browser instead ↗' link. There is no ⟳ in the header on this tab; reload is the ⟳ in the browser bar.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
